what: Rescuers race to free survivors trapped inside train after fatal Indonesia crash

clean_source_blocks.text: Two trains collided on the outskirts of the Indonesian capital on Monday, killing at least 14 people.
Rescuers are racing to try and free people trapped inside a train involved in a fatal collision outside the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday.

The death toll from a train collision near the Indonesian capital Jakarta has risen to 14 with another 84 injured, the train operator said on Tuesday, as rescuers worked to extract survivors still trapped in the wreckage.
Some people screamed "hysterically" as the trains collided, one passenger told the BBC's Indonesia service. Other eyewitnesses said they saw "many victims" injured in the crash.
